title: A Reference Architecture for Integrating Agentic AI into Enterprise Software: Responsibilities, Interactions, and Variability
abstract: arXiv:2610.14818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic AI moves generative AI applications toward systems that coordinate reasoning, enterprise context, model inference, and external actions. Integrating these capabilities into enterprise software introduces diverse architectural concerns, from orchestration, knowledge and memory, and model access to tools and actions, security, runtime infrastructure, and evaluation. Existing research and industry architectures address many of these concerns but differ in scope, abstraction, responsibility organization, interaction representation, and assumptions about which capabilities are required. This paper presents a technology-neutral reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI integration. We synthesize architectural capabilities from research publications, industry architecture guidance, and interoperability specifications by architectural purpose, organize them into ten responsibilities, and define boundary invariants, typed cross-res

translated_title: 将智能体AI集成到企业软件中的参考架构：职责、交互与可变性
translated_abstract: 智能体AI（Agentic AI）正在推动生成式AI应用向能够协调推理、企业上下文、模型推理与外部行动的系统演进。将这些能力集成到企业软件中会引入多样化的架构关注点，涵盖编排、知识与记忆、模型访问、工具与行动、安全性、运行时基础设施以及评估等方面。现有研究和行业架构虽然涉及了其中许多关注点，但在范围、抽象层次、职责组织方式、交互表示形式以及对所需能力的假设等方面存在差异。本文提出了一种技术中立的参考架构，用于企业智能体AI的集成。我们从研究出版物、行业架构指南和互操作性规范中按架构目的综合各类架构能力，将其组织为十项职责，并定义了边界不变量与类型化的跨职责交互……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种技术中立的参考架构，将企业智能体AI集成的各类架构能力按目的归纳为十项职责并定义边界不变量与交互机制，为弥合现有研究与行业方案在范围和组织方式上的差异提供了统一框架。
